update.title: Added a keyboard toggle for the OBS virtual camera
update.summary: Created a keyboard shortcut that starts the background-removal and OBS camera processes in order, then stops both from the same desktop action.

blocks.body:
## Toggle the two-part camera pipeline

I bound Super+O in Wayfire so the virtual camera can start and stop without bringing OBS to the foreground. On start, the script launches RVM, waits up to about five seconds for its output device to become active, warns if that bounded check times out, and then launches OBS minimized. The check sequences the handoff; it does not claim an end-to-end camera verification.

If either OBS or RVM is already running, the same shortcut stops OBS and then RVM. Process checks keep repeated presses from leaving one half of the pipeline behind, while desktop notifications report the requested transition.

blocks.label: RVM Virtual Camera: the background-removal stage

blocks.code:
flowchart LR
  Press[Press Super+O] --> Running{OBS or RVM running?}
  Running -- No --> StartRVM[Start RVM]
  StartRVM --> Check[Bounded output-device check]
  Check --> StartOBS[Launch OBS minimized]
  Running -- Yes --> StopOBS[Stop OBS]
  StopOBS --> StopRVM[Stop RVM]
blocks.description: The shortcut starts the two processes in order or stops both when either half is already running.
